items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My music teacher, Elmira Streets told my father in confidence

ctx.x: What was your mother’s maiden name and could you talk a little bit more about your extended family?

My mother’s name was Bacon. And she was…her family basically lived in Washington D.C. It was the Grayson family I believe…was the early family name, from her mother. Her father, Nathaniel Bacon was…I guess he was Pullman porter. I don’t know very much about my family on that side because my mother was very old when I had the presence of mind to ask her some questions about the family. I was asking her basically about her childhood in Washington D.C. So she had two brothers and a sister, there were four to them.…
What did she have you do? Was it traditional piano lessons?
